children: Coherus Oncology shares retreated after the company said it has begun the process of marketing and selling the remaining assets associated with its former biosimilars business.
The stock is down 4% at $1.25 in midday trading, and has slid 20% in the past 12 months.
The company said it has retained Oppenheimer & Co. to serve as its financial adviser in connection with the sale.

On Aug. 17, the company declared a special dividend of contingent value rights. CVR holders are entitled to receive their pro rata share of any net cash proceeds, and the net cash value of any other consideration, actually received by the company from third parties in connection with the sale of the assets or as licensing fees under any licensing agreement covering the assets.

The assets include patents and other intellectual property; royalties under an existing license agreement; cell lines; and related materials including laboratory notebooks, regulatory filings, and product samples.
